CustomField.description: Developer name of the Form_Theme__mdt applied by the formTemplate runtime to every form rendered within this template, driving colors, fonts, and styling via CSS custom properties. Leave blank to inherit the default theme.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter the developer name of the Form Theme to brand this template's colors and fonts. All pages and sections inherit it. Leave blank to use the default theme.
CustomField.label: Theme
